name: Foum El Bouir
hero_subtitle: Spot de vagues côté Atlantique — énergie océanique au-delà de la lagune.

overview.title: Ocean side of Dakhla
overview.p1: While the lagoon is flat and protected, Foum El Bouir faces the Atlantic with real swell. It is the go-to wave zone for surfers and advanced kiters who want ocean conditions.
overview.p2: Access is by road along the peninsula. Check wind, tide and local advice — open ocean is less forgiving than lagoon shallows.
overview.p3: Not a beginner flat-water classroom. Pair with lagoon days rather than replacing them if you are still learning.

food.title: Manger près de Foum El Bouir
food.p1: Prévoyez les repas en ville, au camp de lagune ou lors d’une dégustation.
food.li1: Eau en bouteille à chaque sortie.
food.li2: Poisson et plats simples en ville.
food.li3: Repas de camp si vous logez sur la lagune.
food.li4: Dégustation d’huîtres quand les fermes sont ouvertes.
food.li5: Vérifiez les horaires avant d’y aller.
food.p2: Les espèces sont utiles hors grands hôtels.

q1.question: Is it for beginners?
q1.answer: No — lagoon flat water is safer for learning; this is an ocean wave zone.

q2.question: Surf and kite?
q2.answer: Both, when conditions allow; local schools know the daily call.

q3.question: How far from town?
q3.answer: Along the peninsula road — ask for current drive time.

q4.question: Facilities?
q4.answer: Limited — bring water and plan as a nature/sport stop.

q5.question: Combine with lagoon?
q5.answer: Yes — many visitors split lagoon days and one ocean session.
